title: Orientation & Introductions
details: Day 1: Explored the labs and machineries, got introduced to the staffs and fellow students, and played a brain-intensive game.
Day 2: Divided into teams to analyze a case study and answer technical questions, followed by a detailed introduction to the 20-week program and past works.
Day 3: Browsed through ZenPencils comics and did a presentation on a comic we could relate to ourselves.
Day 4: Team-building activity - built a spaghetti stick base to balance a marshmallow on top.

title: Foundations
details: Day 1-3: Followed and implemented the principles of 5S.
Day 4-5: Worked on building this portfolio website and hosting it on Vercel.

title: Innovation & Scratch
details: Day 1: We had a session on frugal innovation where an expert came in and gave us some insights in general.
Day 2: We had a session on "Think like a coder" where we were shown videos from TedEd think like a coder series and asked to do the problems that were shown in the videos.
Day 3: We got introduced to scratch and asked to build a fun game or animation. I did a flappy bird game using scratch from scratch.
Day 4: We then got introduced to MIT App Inventor where we built an app that shows the leaderboard of students that are in the protosem.
Day 5: We had a session on "Applied design thinking" where we got to explore forge innovation handbook and now I am updating my portfolio website.
